title: Casinos trust the law of large numbers, not luck
body: Over few trials anything can happen; over millions, averages settle near expectations with shrinking relative deviation. A casino's tiny edge is meaningless per spin and destiny per year. Gamblers feel the short run, businesses budget the long one, and confusing the two funds the building.
source_hint: Law of large numbers (Bernoulli, Ars Conjectandi, 1713)
